sections.name: Corner permutation
sections.description: Match the side colors of the last-layer corners.

sections.name: Corner orientation
sections.description: Put the yellow corner stickers on top.

sets.name: CFOP · PLL
sets.description: All 21 permutation cases. Recognize blocks and headlights; finish with AUF.

sets.name: 4×4 Parity
sets.description: Parity cases after reducing the 4×4 to a 3×3.

sets.name: 5×5 Parity
sets.description: Edge parity during 5×5 edge pairing. There is no PLL parity on a reduced 5×5.

sets.name: CFOP · OLL
sets.description: All 57 orientation cases. Match top stickers and side stickers before choosing a case.

sets.name: CFOP · F2L
sets.description: All 41 standard front-right pair cases. Learn the pairing idea, then apply it to other slots.

sets.name: Roux · CMLL
sets.description: All 42 corner cases. Preserve both blocks; the M-slice edges may change.

sets.name: CFOP · 2-look PLL
sets.description: Place corners first, then solve the remaining edges.

sets.name: One-handed · OLL
sets.description: Complete one-handed case set. Sequences favor left-hand execution; compare grips before building speed.

sets.name: One-handed · PLL
sets.description: Complete one-handed case set. Sequences favor left-hand execution; compare grips before building speed.

sets.name: Roux · Last six edges
sets.description: Tools for EO, UL/UR placement and the final four edges. These are building blocks, not a one-algorithm-per-case set.
